newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Central Bank to announce monetary data.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Central Bank to announce monetary data.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank was due to release October's monetary base data at 1100 local/1300 GMT, a bank spokeswoman said.
The Central Bank would also announce public sector debt levels up to the end of September, the spokeswoman said.

Brazil's monetary base as measured by daily averages expanded 2.4 percent in September while net public sector debt stood at 252.7 billion reais at the end of August, equivalent to 35 percent of gross domestic product.
